lead.en: Saint Louis is the anti-Chong Nonsi: the Silom line's infill station S4 (opened 8 February 2021) sits where North Sathorn becomes South Sathorn, straddling Bang Rak and Sathon, above a neighbourhood of church, hospital and school rather than towers. Saint Louis Hospital (1898, Thailand's first Catholic hospital) is ~200 m from the platform, the Soi Saint Louis 3 food row supplies B40-70 lunches, and the sois read tree-lined and calm. Two ratings strain against the evidence: nightlife 9 despite guides calling the pocket's scene quiet, and green 7 against a mapped 0.0 ha of park. A known caveat, tracked as a pipeline item: the app's station anchor coordinate sits roughly 720 m from the real station node.

strengths.en: Hospital-and-church neighbourhood infrastructure at walking distance: Saint Louis Hospital ~200 m from the platform plus schools and a documented multi-faith cluster.
A genuine local food row (St. Louis Soi 3) with long-standing B40-70 vendors, distinct from tourist Silom.

tradeoffs.en: Nightlife 9 overstates the pocket: the sources describe a quiet, bar-scarce residential soi, with the nearest real bar clusters one or two stops away.
No park inside the unit - Lumphini is ~1.4 km away across Rama IV - so green 7 rests entirely on buffer effects.

dayNight.en: Office-clock days (lunch carts, hospital shifts) give way to shophouse-step evenings; the soi goes quiet well before the Sathorn tower bars do.

variation.en: The station frontage on Sathorn Road is office-block territory; one soi south toward Saint Louis Soi 2-3 the character flips to low-rise residential and food carts.

fit.en: Strong fit: Sathorn/Silom office workers and hospital-adjacent households who want calm, walkable sois and BTS access without interchange crowds.
Poor fit: nightlife-first renters and park users - both 9s/7s in the scorecard trace to neighbouring units' amenities, not this pocket's.

uncertainties: Anchor mismatch: app anchor '@13.7273-ish' vs OSM station node 13.72082, 100.52669 - >=720 m apart; unit membership near the anchor is unreliable pending coordinator verification (saint-louis-c02).
rating nightlife (9): no in-soi venue cluster found in any source; likely catchment-edge borrowing (saint-louis-c06).
rating green (7): zero mapped park confirmed; mechanism inferred (saint-louis-c07).
Rent comparison rests on 2019 listings plus 2026 highlight-level guides; no current portal median for this pocket (saint-louis-c08).
2024-2026 change evidence is thin - a gap, not a verified 'nothing happened'.

limitations: Vendor survival since 2019 not individually verified
All three sources highlight-level or pre-station; the app's 16-venue count not independently reproduced
'Green 7' mechanism inferred, not documented; app's scoring internals unknown
No current portal medians obtained for this pocket; BK listing prices are 7 years old
Absence of findings is not proof of absence; Thai-language search for ย่านเซนต์หลุยส์ news was not run beyond the station article
